elements.text:
Namespaces: channels | mcp-host | mcp-server | control-plane | profiles | rpc-proxy | sandbox-recipes
Security: deny-all NPs per namespace, pod securityContext, RBAC scoped (PR #74)
1,944 tests  |  8 E2E suites  |  5 TypeScript services  |  5 CRDs

Internal Output Tools (clerum__*):
  clerum__generate_markdown  (.md)
  clerum__generate_pdf       (.pdf)
  clerum__generate_docx      (.docx)
  clerum__generate_xlsx      (.xlsx)

LLM Providers:
  OpenAI | Claude | ZAI (z.ai) | Bailian

Transports: HTTP (StreamableHTTP) | stdio

JWT Auth Chain:
  control-api signs JWT (iss=control-api, aud=rpc-proxy, TTL=300s)
  Desktop App → rpc-proxy → mcp-host (passthrough)
  SSE stream: 3x 401 → auth-expired → auto-reconnect

Deploy Order (Mandatory):
  1. CRDs → 2. RBAC → 3. Secrets/keys
  → 4. ConfigMaps → 5. Images (sequential)
Prod: GKE us-central1-a  |  Dev: minikube (clerum-test)

Features:
  14 K8s manifests  |  81 unit tests  |  17 seed entries (7 local + 5 remote + 5 recipes)
  14 search filters + FTS  |  semver + trust matrix  |  quality tier promotion
  control-api registryClient proxy  |  rate limiter  |  auth middleware

Key: registry-api/  |  Namespace: registry  |  81 tests passing
MCP EGRESS PROXY  (External MCP Servers — Implemented in Branch)

Remote MCP Servers
(OpenAI, Brave, Custom HTTP)

Implemented (5-layer security):
  1. CRD: spec.remote.baseUrl + CEL validation (HTTPS-only, no internal URLs)
  2. HCC: isRemote() + buildNginxConfigMap() + ensureConfigMap()
     clerum/nginx-egress-proxy:0.1.0 Deployment + ConfigMap + Service + NP
  3. sanitizeRemoteUrl(): SSRF prevention (RFC1918, loopback, link-local, IPv6)
  4. Control UI: Local/Remote toggle in CreateMcpServerForm
  5. RegistryInstallModal: remote flow + warning banner + egressBindings
  6. Tests: 18 sanitizeRemoteUrl tests + 4 remote flow + CRD CEL rules

Commits: a136102 (impl) + 0c7ff1d (security audit) + 34ea40e (sessions 2+3)

Legend:  Green = Production Ready (master)  |  Blue = Implemented in Branch (PR #77)  |  Yellow = Status Badge  |  Red = Database/Storage
Clerum v0.9.5  |  GKE us-central1-a  |  Branch: clerum-registry-mcp-workflow  |  19 commits post-merge  |  2026-03-29
